requiredBehavior: Receipt data describes the historical replay environment only; never expose future receipt fields to strategy decisions or call it a causal live model.
Join labels to exact normalized trade identity, sourceMs, original sequence/frame index and original arrival; require unique conserved token/side/size settlement groups.
Preserve per-maker route, actual price and quantity. Never treat public boundary price as weighted average or complement the full aggregate volume.
Use unique exchange/transaction/OrdersMatched-index/maker-log-index identity globally; repeated public observations cannot reuse venue volume.
For labelled public trades, replace legacy aggregate liquidity with conserved DIRECT/MINT maker portions. Do not add both legacy full aggregate fills and labelled component fills.
No MINT credit on missing, conflicting or ambiguous labels; partial label coverage remains explicitly NO_GO.
Require active order, trade source after observed activation, both books fresh and source not before either current book. Cancel-due wins ties; GAP/terminal invalidation cannot resurrect orders.
Process price priority and share residual volume across all virtual orders once. Keep the original queue multiplier and own-order queue precedence, with no cancellation credit.
Keep account reservation, fees, exit policy, markout validity, gap handling and risk stops unchanged. Compare the same baseline strategy and data, not a retuned profitable candidate.
Report missing queue/hidden-liquidity knowledge as model uncertainty; do not promote venue MINT observations into actual bot fills or independent profitability evidence.
nextImplementation: Add a default-off research-only settlement-labelled matching path with synthetic conservation/causality tests, then same-development baseline comparison. Validate adverse one-leg risk before proposing any strategy change.
